claims.value: Complex global-SU4 fundamental H decomposes into ordinary H=A and twin B. Source retains the linear radial mode and explicitly does not use the purely nonlinear theory. No extra elementary radial singlet is added on top of these doublets.

locator.anchor: are therefore absent in our minimal

claims.value: Minimal twin gauge algebra is su3 x su2, no twin hypercharge. One twin quark doublet, RH top/bottom, one LH lepton doublet and RH tau, plus complex B doublet; no first/second twin families. RH quarks conjugate twin colour as well as all charges. Twin neutrino is in Lhat, not an additional RH neutrino. Full ordinary SM inherited.

Source-explicit SM/MSSM inheritance is expanded using the declared atlas baseline: three ordinary SM chiral families, no independent RH neutrino unless stated. Exact Dynkin and all-LH conversion are conventions/derivations, not newly printed source tables. Gauge connections and dependent conjugates are not extra matter.

fields.derivation: Exact highest weights use dynkin-gauge-1. prepare_entry expands identified 4D Dirac/RH fermions into LH conjugates of every factor, and applies one primitive positive charge unit over the entire inventory. Retain source-coordinate row above; scalar-realification equivalence is NOT implemented.
